business_problem: As one of Singapore’s largest law firms, Rajah & Tann is a leader in innovation, pioneering the adoption and implementation of emerging technologies that continue to shape and reshape legal workflows. With an esteemed reputation and operations stretching across 10 countries, the firm found itself under mounting pressure to oversee a growing number of cases, while delivering at the same speed and level of quality for which they are known.
solution_summary: As one of Singapore’s largest law firms, Rajah & Tann is a leader in innovation, pioneering the adoption and implementation of emerging technologies that continue to shape and reshape legal workflows. With an esteemed reputation and operations stretching across 10 countries, the firm found itself under mounting pressure to oversee a growing number of cases, while delivering at the same speed and level of quality for which they are known. Recognizing the potential of AI to assist in the management of large legal data loads, Rajah & Tann turned to Crayon, a global leader in IT services and customer-centric innovation, to help them adopt and deploy Copilot for Microsoft 365, making them the first corporate customer in ASEAN to acquire Microsoft’s AI-powered productivity tool.

solution_components.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Assists employees inside Microsoft 365 apps with drafting, summarization, search, and task execution.

With the possibilities around AI continuing to grow, Rajah & Tann saw an opportunity to change the way lawyers tackle the massive amounts of data they are faced with.
Pioneering Copilot for Microsoft 365 adoption in the ASEAN legal industry

To help take the next step in its digital transformation, Rajah & Tann contracted Crayon, an Azure Expert MSP and one of Microsoft’s key partners offering Copilot for Microsoft 365 solutions, to help guide it through its AI adoption journey.

Offering a range of Copilot for Microsoft 365 services, from technical readiness to adoption and change management to extensibility, Crayon came well equipped to facilitate Rajah & Tann’s AI transformation through ongoing training and support.
